images.author: Tysto
images.caption:
City Hall in Celina, Ohio.  It is part of the Celina Main Street Commercial Historic District, which is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.






This is an image of a place or buildin

facade.notes: Celina OH city hall and fire department (1892): a red-brick Richardsonian Romanesque hall on a corner with a tall square tower, an open arched belfry and a pyramidal cap, a big arched entrance in brownstone, a hipped roof with a gable, two arched engine-house doors (with a painted firefighter mural) on the side; awnings, a pole light

why.note: the combined city hall and firehouse: the tower for the bell and drying hoses, visible down Main Street
